snippet.title: Paper Mario: Star Nova - Reveal Trailer | NicTube
snippet.description:
Join the Discord server for more info!
https://discord.gg/RpvqnCXVhY

Paper Mario: Star Nova is a (planned) multi-chapter Paper Mario 64 romhack made by me.
Mario somehow ends up at Star Port, a sacred archipelago somewhere next to the Mushroom Kingdom, and tries to find a way back. Until...

[This trailer only includes footage of the beginning of the game. More story to come as more info is revealed.]

What to expect:

・ Brand new story
・ New characters & new main villain
・ New partners with (partly) new abilities
・ New items & badges
・ Multiple Chapters + Sidequests
・ Lots of new enemies & bosses
・ New music (remixes)

I might also post some info on Twitter, so you could follow me there as well: 
https://twitter.com/NicTube
